-- ── Strings ── a 1.12 GlobalStrings global, or the fallback for a harness without them. function BenillaKeyBindings_String(name, fallback) local s = getglobal(name) if s then return s end return fallback end
-- ── Key display ── 1.12's GetBindingText in full form: modifier prefixes stay tokens, the -- base key reads its KEY_* global. "CTRL--" is CTRL plus the minus key. function BenillaKeyBindings_KeyText(key) if not key then return NORMAL_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. BenillaKeyBindings_String("NOT_BOUND", "Not Bound") .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE end local prefix = "" local rest = key while true do local p = string.sub(rest, 1, 4) if p == "ALT-" then prefix = prefix .. "ALT-" rest = string.sub(rest, 5) elseif string.sub(rest, 1, 5) == "CTRL-" then prefix = prefix .. "CTRL-" rest = string.sub(rest, 6) elseif string.sub(rest, 1, 6) == "SHIFT-" then prefix = prefix .. "SHIFT-" rest = string.sub(rest, 7) else break end end -- A lone modifier ("SHIFT-", the kart's boost) reads as the modifier. if rest == "" then return strsub(prefix, 1, -2) end -- Kartcraft's controller buttons, which 1.12 has no KEY_* name for; R2 is the pad's -- Shift and L2 its Ctrl, so a pad button's SHIFT- reads "R2 + " and its CTRL- "L2 + ". local pad = BENILLA_KEY_PADS and BENILLA_KEY_PADS[rest] if not pad and string.sub(rest, 1, 3) == "PAD" then pad = rest end if pad then if string.find(prefix, "SHIFT-", 1, 1) then prefix = string.gsub(prefix, "SHIFT%-", "") .. "R2 + " end if string.find(prefix, "CTRL-", 1, 1) then prefix = string.gsub(prefix, "CTRL%-", "") .. "L2 + " end return prefix .. pad end return prefix .. BenillaKeyBindings_String("KEY_" .. rest, rest) end
-- ── Page state ── `searchPainted` maps OptionsFrame.xml's search rows to binding indices. BenillaKeyBindingsPage = { sections = {}, items = {} }
BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_ROW_BASE = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsRow" BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_DISPLAYED = 19 BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_ROW_HEIGHT = 25 BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS = 8
-- ── Section model ── one section per `HEADER_*` row of the binding list, in its -- order (Blizzard_BindingUI.lua:84-92), collapsed at first as in the era; a rebuild keeps -- each state. `token` is the header's GlobalStrings key, `fallback` its bare name. -- Deviation: the spacer headers BLANK, BLANK2 and BLANK3 over multibars 2-4 -- (Bindings.xml:883/967/1051), which 1.12 draws blank (BINDING_HEADER_BLANK is " ", the -- other two are not defined), continue the section above, because this page's sections -- are named and collapsible. function BenillaKeyBindings_IsHeader(command) return strsub(command, 1, 6) == "HEADER" end
function BenillaKeyBindings_BuildSections() local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage local was = {} for _, s in ipairs(page.sections) do was[s.token] = s.expanded end page.sections = {} local sec = nil for i = 1, GetNumBindings() do local command = GetBinding(i) if BenillaKeyBindings_IsHeader(command) then local token = "BINDING_" .. command if not (sec and strfind(command, "^HEADER_BLANK%d*$")) then sec = { token = token, fallback = strsub(command, 8), indices = {}, expanded = was[token] } table.insert(page.sections, sec) end elseif sec then table.insert(sec.indices, i) end end BenillaKeyBindings_Flatten() end
-- The visible list the faux scroll runs over. function BenillaKeyBindings_Flatten() local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage page.items = {} for n, sec in ipairs(page.sections) do table.insert(page.items, { header = n }) if sec.expanded then for _, i in ipairs(sec.indices) do table.insert(page.items, { bind = i }) end end end end
-- A header click, voiced with the checkbox sound. function BenillaKeyBindings_ToggleSection(n) local sec = BenillaKeyBindingsPage.sections[n] if not sec then return end PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") sec.expanded = not sec.expanded BenillaKeyBindings_Flatten() BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Update() end
-- Silent, for the capture fixture. function BenillaKeyBindings_ExpandSection(n, on) local sec = BenillaKeyBindingsPage.sections[n] if not sec then return end sec.expanded = on and true or false BenillaKeyBindings_Flatten() end
-- ── Painters ── shared by the list and the search rows, which capture in place. -- ── Keys and controller buttons ── a PAD key under any modifiers is a controller button. function BenillaKeyBindings_IsPad(key) if not key then return nil end local rest = key while true do if string.sub(rest, 1, 4) == "ALT-" then rest = string.sub(rest, 5) elseif string.sub(rest, 1, 5) == "CTRL-" then rest = string.sub(rest, 6) elseif string.sub(rest, 1, 6) == "SHIFT-" then rest = string.sub(rest, 7) else break end end return string.sub(rest, 1, 3) == "PAD" end
-- A command's keys and its controller buttons, each in binding order: GetBinding's row -- names them all, where GetBindingKey stops at two. function BenillaKeyBindings_KeysOf(command) local keys, pads = {}, {} for i = 1, GetNumBindings() do local row = { GetBinding(i) } if row[1] == command then for j = 2, table.getn(row) do if BenillaKeyBindings_IsPad(row[j]) then table.insert(pads, row[j]) else table.insert(keys, row[j]) end end break end end return keys, pads end
-- The Controller capsule's text: its buttons, or Not Bound; two or more in short ("Pad -- Cross / A" as "Cross/A"), to fit the capsule. function BenillaKeyBindings_PadText(pads) local n = table.getn(pads) if n == 0 then return BenillaKeyBindings_KeyText(nil) end if n == 1 then return BenillaKeyBindings_KeyText(pads[1]) end local out = {} for i = 1, n do local text = BenillaKeyBindings_KeyText(pads[i]) text = string.gsub(text, "^Pad ", "") text = string.gsub(text, "R2 %+ Pad ", "R2+") text = string.gsub(text, " / ", "/") table.insert(out, text) end return table.concat(out, ", ") end
function BenillaKeyBindings_PaintBindRow(name, index) local command = GetBinding(index) local keys, pads = BenillaKeyBindings_KeysOf(command) local key1, key2 = keys[1], keys[2] local b1 = getglobal(name .. "Key1Button") local b2 = getglobal(name .. "Key2Button") local b3 = getglobal(name .. "Key3Button") b1.commandName = command b2.commandName = command b3.commandName = command b1:SetText(BenillaKeyBindings_KeyText(key1)) b2:SetText(BenillaKeyBindings_KeyText(key2)) b3:SetText(BenillaKeyBindings_PadText(pads)) if key1 then b1:SetAlpha(1) else b1:SetAlpha(0.8) end if key2 then b2:SetAlpha(1) else b2:SetAlpha(0.8) end if pads[1] then b3:SetAlpha(1) else b3:SetAlpha(0.8) end local desc = getglobal(name .. "Description") desc:SetText(BenillaKeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. command, command)) desc:Show() local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage if page.selected == command and page.keyID == 1 then b1:LockHighlight() else b1:UnlockHighlight() end if page.selected == command and page.keyID == 2 then b2:LockHighlight() else b2:UnlockHighlight() end if page.selected == command and page.keyID == 3 then b3:LockHighlight() else b3:UnlockHighlight() end b1:Show() b2:Show() b3:Show() getglobal(name .. "Header"):Hide() end
function BenillaKeyBindings_PaintHeaderRow(name, n) local sec = BenillaKeyBindingsPage.sections[n] local header = getglobal(name .. "Header") header.sectionIndex = n header:SetText(BenillaKeyBindings_String(sec.token, sec.fallback)) local icon = getglobal(name .. "HeaderIcon") if sec.expanded then icon:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-MinusButton-Up") else icon:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-PlusButton-Up") end header:Show() getglobal(name .. "Description"):Hide() getglobal(name .. "Key1Button"):Hide() getglobal(name .. "Key2Button"):Hide() getglobal(name .. "Key3Button"):Hide() end
-- ── The list repaint (1.12 KeyBindingFrame_Update) ── function BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Update() local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage local scroll = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsScrollFrame") local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scroll) for i = 1, BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_DISPLAYED do local name = BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_ROW_BASE .. i local row = getglobal(name) local item = page.items[offset + i] if item and item.header then BenillaKeyBindings_PaintHeaderRow(name, item.header) row:Show() elseif item then BenillaKeyBindings_PaintBindRow(name, item.bind) row:Show() else row:Hide() end end FauxScrollFrame_Update(scroll, table.getn(page.items), BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_DISPLAYED, BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_ROW_HEIGHT) -- Our trough follows the bar `FauxScrollFrame_Update` has just shown or hidden. BenillaScrollTrough_Follow(scroll:GetName()) BenillaKeyBindings_UpdateUnbindKey() end
-- The page entry: a rebind or a set switch may have changed the table. function BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Refresh() BenillaKeyBindings_BuildSections() local box = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsCharacterRowCheck") if GetCurrentBindingSet() == 2 then box:SetChecked(1) else box:SetChecked(nil) end getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsScrollFrameScrollBar"):SetValue(0) BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Update() end
function BenillaKeyBindings_Output(text) getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindingsOutput"):SetText(text) end
-- ── Selection ── while a capsule is selected the window takes every key and the -- wheel, as 1.12's keyboard-enabled KeyBindingFrame does (Blizzard_BindingUI.xml:73, -- :541-543); unarmed it takes neither, so keys and the wheel reach the game. function BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(command, keyID) BenillaKeyBindingsPage.selected = command BenillaKeyBindingsPage.keyID = keyID if BenillaOptionsFrame then BenillaOptionsFrame:EnableKeyboard(command ~= nil) BenillaOptionsFrame:EnableMouseWheel(command ~= nil) end end
function BenillaKeyBindings_UpdateUnbindKey() local unbind = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerUnbind") if BenillaKeyBindingsPage.selected then unbind:Enable() else unbind:Disable() end end
-- Every search row: a bind from one can unbind a victim shown on another. function BenillaKeyBindings_RepaintVisible() if BenillaKeyBindingsPage.searchPainted then for name, index in pairs(BenillaKeyBindingsPage.searchPainted) do BenillaKeyBindings_PaintBindRow(name, index) end BenillaKeyBindings_UpdateUnbindKey() else BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Update() end end
-- 1.12's KeyBindingButton_OnClick (Blizzard_BindingUI.lua:228-258): while armed, a middle, -- 4 or 5 click binds that button. function BenillaKeyBindingButton_OnClick(button) local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage if page.selected then if button ~= "LeftButton" and button ~= "RightButton" then BenillaKeyBindings_OnKeyDown(button) return end if page.selected == this.commandName and page.keyID == this:GetID() then BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) BenillaKeyBindings_Output("") else BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(this.commandName, this:GetID()) BenillaKeyBindings_Output(string.format( BenillaKeyBindings_String("BIND_KEY_TO_COMMAND", "Press Key to Bind to Command -> %s"), BenillaKeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. this.commandName, this.commandName))) end else BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(this.commandName, this:GetID()) BenillaKeyBindings_Output(string.format( BenillaKeyBindings_String("BIND_KEY_TO_COMMAND", "Press Key to Bind to Command -> %s"), BenillaKeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. this.commandName, this.commandName))) end BenillaKeyBindings_RepaintVisible() end
function BenillaKeyBindings_Commit() SaveBindings(GetCurrentBindingSet()) end
-- 1.12's KeyBindingFrame_OnKeyDown armed branch (Blizzard_BindingUI.lua:140-212), then -- the live commit: `button` is a mouse button's or the wheel's name, else the key is -- `arg1`, the window's OnKeyDown argument. Unarmed it does nothing: the window takes keys -- only while armed, so 1.12's unarmed ESCAPE arm never runs here. function BenillaKeyBindings_OnKeyDown(button) local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage if not page.selected then return end if button == "LeftButton" then button = "BUTTON1" elseif button == "RightButton" then button = "BUTTON2" elseif button == "MiddleButton" then button = "BUTTON3" elseif button == "Button4" then button = "BUTTON4" elseif button == "Button5" then button = "BUTTON5" end local chord if button then if button == "BUTTON1" or button == "BUTTON2" then return end chord = button else chord = arg1 end -- A modifier alone is no key; R2 and L2 are the controller's (Kartcraft's). if chord == "UNKNOWN" or chord == "SHIFT" or chord == "CTRL" or chord == "ALT" or chord == "PADRTRIGGER" or chord == "PADLTRIGGER" then return end if IsShiftKeyDown() then chord = "SHIFT-" .. chord end if IsControlKeyDown() then chord = "CTRL-" .. chord end if IsAltKeyDown() then chord = "ALT-" .. chord end local selected = page.selected local keys, pads = BenillaKeyBindings_KeysOf(selected) local isPad = BenillaKeyBindings_IsPad(chord) -- The Controller capsule takes a controller button only; Escape disarms it. if page.keyID == 3 and not isPad then if chord == "ESCAPE" then BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) BenillaKeyBindings_Output("") BenillaKeyBindings_RepaintVisible() else BenillaKeyBindings_Output("Press a controller button to bind it, or Escape.") end return end -- Who holds the chord now: a holder this bind leaves keyless is told so, as 1.12's -- window tells it (Blizzard_BindingUI.lua:186-196), once the keys have moved. local holders = BenillaKeyBindings_Holders(chord) local bound if isPad then -- A controller button, from any capsule: the command's buttons are this one. for i = 1, table.getn(pads) do BenillaKeyBindings_ClearKey(pads[i], selected) end bound = BenillaKeyBindings_SetOrRestore(chord, selected, pads[1]) else local key1, key2 = keys[1], keys[2] if key1 then BenillaKeyBindings_ClearKey(key1, selected) end if key2 then BenillaKeyBindings_ClearKey(key2, selected) end if page.keyID == 1 then bound = BenillaKeyBindings_SetOrRestore(chord, selected, key1) if key2 then SetBinding(key2, selected) end else if key1 then SetBinding(key1, selected) end bound = BenillaKeyBindings_SetOrRestore(chord, selected, key2) end end if bound then local lost = nil for _, holder in ipairs(holders) do if holder ~= selected and not GetBindingKey(holder) then lost = lost or holder end end if lost then BenillaKeyBindings_Output(string.format( BenillaKeyBindings_String("KEY_UNBOUND_ERROR", "|cffff0000%s Function is Now Unbound!|r"), BenillaKeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. lost, lost))) else BenillaKeyBindings_Output(BenillaKeyBindings_String("KEY_BOUND", "Key Bound Successfully")) end end BenillaKeyBindings_Commit() BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) BenillaKeyBindings_RepaintVisible() end
-- The commands `key` is bound to, in list order. One key may hold a WoW command and one -- of the kart's driving controls at once (the engine's overlay plane). function BenillaKeyBindings_Holders(key) local out = {} for i = 1, GetNumBindings() do local row = { GetBinding(i) } for j = 2, table.getn(row) do if row[j] == key then table.insert(out, row[1]) break end end end return out end
-- Take `key` from `command` alone. SetBinding(key) unbinds the key from every command, as -- 1.12's does, so each other command that held it is bound again, its keys in their order. function BenillaKeyBindings_ClearKey(key, command) local others = {} for i = 1, GetNumBindings() do local row = { GetBinding(i) } if row[1] ~= command then for j = 2, table.getn(row) do if row[j] == key then table.insert(others, row) break end end end end SetBinding(key) for _, row in ipairs(others) do for j = 2, table.getn(row) do SetBinding(row[j], row[1]) end end end
-- 1.12's KeyBindingFrame_SetBinding, message and all; SetBinding refuses only a non-key. -- Answers whether the key bound. function BenillaKeyBindings_SetOrRestore(key, command, oldKey) if not SetBinding(key, command) then if oldKey then SetBinding(oldKey, command) end BenillaKeyBindings_Output(BenillaKeyBindings_String( "KEYBINDINGFRAME_MOUSEWHEEL_ERROR", "Can't bind mousewheel to actions with up and down states")) return nil end return 1 end
-- The list's OnMouseWheel while armed (Blizzard_BindingUI.xml:377-387). function BenillaKeyBindings_OnMouseWheel(delta) if delta > 0 then BenillaKeyBindings_OnKeyDown("MOUSEWHEELUP") else BenillaKeyBindings_OnKeyDown("MOUSEWHEELDOWN") end end
-- 1.12's Unbind Key body, then the live commit. function BenillaKeyBindings_Unbind() local page = BenillaKeyBindingsPage local keys, pads = BenillaKeyBindings_KeysOf(page.selected) if page.keyID == 3 then -- The Controller capsule: every controller button the command has. for i = 1, table.getn(pads) do BenillaKeyBindings_ClearKey(pads[i], page.selected) end else local key1, key2 = keys[1], keys[2] if key1 then BenillaKeyBindings_ClearKey(key1, page.selected) end if key2 then BenillaKeyBindings_ClearKey(key2, page.selected) end if key1 and page.keyID == 1 then if key2 then SetBinding(key2, page.selected) end else if key1 then SetBinding(key1, page.selected) end end end BenillaKeyBindings_Commit() BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) BenillaKeyBindings_Output("") BenillaKeyBindings_RepaintVisible() end
-- ── Character-specific set ── checking saves set 2 at once (LoadBindings(2) falls back -- to the account set); unchecking confirms first, as the era does. The accept loads set 1 -- before saving it, or the character binds would be written into the account set. function BenillaKeyBindings_CharacterToggle(box) PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") if box:GetChecked() then LoadBindings(2) SaveBindings(2) BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) BenillaKeyBindings_Output("") BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Refresh() else box:SetChecked(1) StaticPopup_Show("BENILLA_CONFIRM_DELETING_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_BINDINGS") end end
-- Our key: Blizzard_BindingUI.lua:10 defines the stock one for its own window. StaticPopupDialogs["BENILLA_CONFIRM_DELETING_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_BINDINGS"] = { text = BenillaKeyBindings_String("CONFIRM_DELETING_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_BINDINGS", "Really switch to general key bindings? All key bindings specific to this character will be permanantly deleted."), button1 = BenillaKeyBindings_String("OKAY", "Okay"), button2 = BenillaKeyBindings_String("CANCEL", "Cancel"), OnAccept = function() LoadBindings(1) SaveBindings(1) BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) BenillaKeyBindings_Output("") BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Refresh() end, } -- Reset To Default confirms, as the era's does; our string, since 1.12 has none. StaticPopupDialogs["BENILLA_CONFIRM_RESET_KEYBINDINGS"] = { text = "Are you sure you want to reset all keybindings to their defaults?", button1 = BenillaKeyBindings_String("OKAY", "Okay"), button2 = BenillaKeyBindings_String("CANCEL", "Cancel"), OnAccept = function() PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") LoadBindings(0) BenillaKeyBindings_Commit() BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) BenillaKeyBindings_Output("") BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Refresh() end, }
-- ── Search ── a binding's tag is its display name uppercased, as the era's. -- A static pool of BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS rows, where the era's results scroll. function BenillaKeyBindings_SearchMatches(words) local out = {} for i = 1, GetNumBindings() do local command = GetBinding(i) if not BenillaKeyBindings_IsHeader(command) then local tag = string.upper(BenillaKeyBindings_String("BINDING_NAME_" .. command, command)) local s = BenillaOptionsSearch_Score(tag, words) if s then table.insert(out, { score = s, index = i }) end end end return out end
